interval_implementation: All proof arithmetic is enclosed by precision50 Decimal operations with explicit ROUND_FLOOR/ROUND_CEILING in local contexts. Exact float-to-Decimal input conversion, copy_negate and copy_abs avoid ambient-context rounding.
Complex density uses exact normalized outer products; probability uses normalized squared complex inner product. Division rejects denominators enclosing zero; nonfinite inputs fail.
Dependency/interval overestimation can suppress a certificate but cannot create a strictly positive lower-gap certificate if operations enclose their exact values.
